picks.title: Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle Plus and expands access to audiobooks
picks.excerpt: Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle Plus; subscribers get access to more audiobooks, including some read by AI narrators, at the same monthly price.
picks.rationale: Amazon is rebranding its biggest ebook subscription and adding AI-narrated audiobooks to it. That puts AI narration in front of millions of readers and changes what KDP authors can earn from subscription reads.

picks.title: Library and Archives Canada cracking down on AI books amid copyright threats
picks.excerpt: LAC updated its ISBN policy to limit registrations for primarily AI-generated books; registrants must now declare a human author. Canadian author groups welcomed the change.
picks.rationale: A national ISBN agency has made a new policy decision: registrants must now declare a human author, which limits ISBNs for mostly AI-generated books. This changes what Canadian self-publishers must do to register a book.

picks.title: New Meta commercial terms might have granted it AI training rights, until it changed course
picks.excerpt: After publisher outcry, Meta modified its commercial terms to remove the word 'train' from permitted uses of content shared on its platforms.
picks.rationale: After publishers objected, Meta removed AI-training rights from its commercial terms. This affects anyone who posts book content on Meta platforms.

picks.title: PLA Partners with Microsoft on Library AI Info Sessions
picks.excerpt: The Public Library Association and Microsoft launch AI education sessions in public libraries starting in December, aimed at helping patrons 'exercise their agency when it comes to AI.'
picks.rationale: A new program: the Public Library Association and Microsoft will run AI education sessions for patrons in US public libraries starting in December.

picks.title: "태그만 고르면 2분 만에 웹소설"…모사재인, 일본 진출
picks.excerpt: AI 스타트업 모사재인이 일본에 맞춤형 AI 웹소설 플랫폼 '아이로쿠'를 출시했다. 장르·배경·인물을 고르면 여러 AI 에이전트가 약 2분 만에 첫 화를 생성한다.
picks.rationale: A new product launch where AI is the whole product: Mosajaein's Airoku platform in Japan uses several AI agents to write a reader-customised first web-novel episode in about two minutes.
